text.en:
The name of the Cumadcad Emergency Hospital in Barangay Cumadcad, Municipality of
Castilla, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby changed to Vicente L. Peralta Memorial Hospital.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 10, 1981
